question: How many customers are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers;

question: How many orders were cancelled?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

question: List all product names in the Electronics category.
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Electronics';

question: What is the price of the Wireless Earbuds?
expected_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE product_name = 'Wireless Earbuds';

question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01';

question: How many customers are from Hyderabad?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Hyderabad';

question: Show the 5 most expensive products.
expected_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average rating of the Wireless Earbuds?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Wireless Earbuds';

question: How many products are out of stock?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock_qty = 0;

question: What is the total quantity sold of the Yoga Mat?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Yoga Mat';

question: How many customers signed up in 2023?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2023-01-01' AND signup_date < '2024-01-01';

question: How many orders were paid by UPI?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE payment_method = 'UPI';

question: Which category has the most products?
expected_sql: SELECT c.category_name FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders in 2024?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01';

question: How many reviews have a rating of 5?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5;

question: How many customers from Visakhapatnam placed more than 3 orders?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Visakhapatnam' GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3);

question: What is the average order value for delivered orders?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS t FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.order_id);

question: List the products launched after 2024-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE launch_date > '2024-01-01';

question: Show me the best products.

interpretations.label: highest sales (units sold)
interpretations.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS score FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id  GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5;

interpretations.label: highest average rating
interpretations.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, AVG(r.rating) AS score FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id  GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5;

interpretations.label: highest profit
interpretations.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS score FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id  GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Who are our top customers?

interpretations.label: total spend
interpretations.expected_sql: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS score FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id  GROUP BY c.full_name ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5;

interpretations.label: number of orders
interpretations.expected_sql: SELECT c.full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS score FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id  GROUP BY c.full_name ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5;
